fields.description:
Sibling of bug 3d57-602f-0b75-48ee (found in its Step-7 construct sweep): the completion child-closure gate pays a full-store scan per child (and up to 5 with legacy fingerprint retries + the stale-material explanation) when closing a container.

## Mechanism

src/rebar/llm/completion_child_gate.py loops a parent's direct children and calls compute_validity(sig, c, "completion-verifier") per child; the completion branch (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py:568-574) recomputes current_material_fingerprint (1 full-store reduce via relation_snapshot.live_material_children -> _reads.list_tickets(parent=...)) and on mismatch tries _legacy_material_ok (3 more full computations) plus explain_material_change (1 more). A container close with N children costs O(5N) full-store scans (measured: 6 scans for 1 child, 21 for 4).

## Fix

Same remedy shape as bug 3d57 (commit 14aa285f963): open `with material_child_index(repo_root=repo_root):` around the per-child validity loop in completion_child_gate.py (extracted as _classify_children so the snapshot wraps exactly the loop that fingerprints). One wide scan per close instead of O(5N). Correctness precedent: the snapshot's fast path filters through counts_as_plan_material_child, byte-identical to the slow path (proven in bug 3d57; regression test tests/unit/test_pin_health_store_scan_count.py shows the counting pattern reused here).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Full-store reduce count during a container close's child-closure check does not grow with child count — proven by `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_completion_child_gate_scan_count.py::test_child_gate_scan_count_constant_in_child_count` (RED before the fix: 6 vs 21 scans; GREEN after).
- [x] Gate verdicts unchanged: a child attesting its true current fingerprint stays certified, a stale child lands uncertified, an unclosed child still blocks — proven by `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_completion_child_gate_scan_count.py` (verdict-correctness guards).
- [x] `make lint` + `make typecheck` + complexity ratchet (`python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check`) clean.

## Testing

RED-first counting-seam regression test tests/unit/test_completion_child_gate_scan_count.py (mirrors tests/unit/test_pin_health_store_scan_count.py): monkeypatch-counts rebar._engine_support.reads.reduce_all_tickets, asserts scan count constant in child count, plus verdict-correctness and unclosed-child blocking guards. Mutation check: fix reverted returns the test to RED.
